truth_evidence: Affected every release before 2.10.1; fixed in 2.10.1 (str.format_map bypassed the str.format sandboxing added for CVE-2016-10745).

The advisory links no commit (only the release blog post). The fix is a2a6c930 'sandbox str.format_map', the only code commit between tags 2.10 and 2.10.1. https://github.com/pallets/jinja/commit/a2a6c930bcca591a25d2b316fcfd2d6793897b26
SandboxedEnvironment.format_string: gains a format_func parameter and unpacks the single mapping argument for format_map.
Entry points: the sandbox classes; call and format_string are public methods on the path.
